projectDescription: A principal-level, 16-division multi-agent configuration layer for Claude Code that provides drop-in ~/.claude/ setup with Floor and Library rules, skills, specialist agents, slash commands, and hook-enforced quality gates.
keyFeatures: 16-division multi-agent Council (5 Core + 11 Extended) covering architecture, security, compliance, ops, data, finance, ethics, and more
26 always-loaded Floor rules and 187 on-demand Library rules enforcing principal-level standards
119 skills for reusable patterns across code quality, security, backend, infrastructure, finance, and AI/ML
39 specialist agents with explicit veto authority and model-tier selection (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku/Fable)
33 slash commands for code review, TDD, refactoring, build fixes, multi-agent orchestration, and learning
25+ hook scripts providing mechanical quality gates at every lifecycle event (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart, PreCompact, Stop)
Cross-IDE support for VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, JetBrains, and terminal editors
Native Codex CLI installer with hook review, plan mapping, and lifecycle compatibility
Continuous learning loop that promotes cross-project patterns to global via audits/learning-events.jsonl
Cross-platform install: macOS/Linux (bash) and Windows (PowerShell native, no WSL2 required)
publicApiSurface: bootstrap/install.sh — macOS/Linux/WSL2 installer
bootstrap/install.ps1 — Windows PowerShell installer
bootstrap/verify.sh / verify.ps1 — post-install integrity verifier
bootstrap/uninstall.sh / uninstall.ps1 — reversible uninstaller
bootstrap/context.py — additive context migration for existing Claude installs
bootstrap/codex.py install / verify / uninstall — native Codex lifecycle installer
/code-review — comprehensive security and quality review slash command
/learn — extract reusable patterns from current session
/verify — run build, lint, type check, tests, and code-graph validation
/evolve — evolve existing rules and skills based on session learnings
/plan — create or update a structured implementation plan
/tdd — test-driven development workflow
/build-fix — diagnose and fix build errors
/e2e — end-to-end test runner command
/orchestrate — multi-agent orchestration workflow
/instinct-status / instinct-export / instinct-import — manage learned instincts
/checkpoint — save session checkpoint to plan memory
/refactor-clean — dead code removal and dependency cleanup
agents/architect.md — system design and ADR specialist
agents/security-reviewer.md — OWASP/ASVS/STRIDE auditor with VETO authority
agents/compliance-reviewer.md — GDPR/HIPAA/PCI/SOC2 auditor with VETO authority
agents/code-reviewer.md — cross-language severity-based code review
agents/tdd-guide.md — test-first TDD workflow agent
agents/planner.md — phased delivery and dependency analysis
scripts/token-budget.mjs — measure and enforce context budget
